name: Spark Disks
summary: Drives and partitions: mount, format, resize, check health and write an image to a USB stick.
summary_fr: Disques et partitions : monter, formater, redimensionner, vérifier la santé et écrire une image sur une clé USB.

optional.smartctl: drive health (SMART) on drives that report it

needs.system: Linux with udisks2 and polkit; the password is asked by polkit when a change needs it
